overview_description.description: Paper is a developer of an educational platform designed to make personalized tutoring available to all students. It provides tutoring, after-school enrichment, and college and career resources to support students at every step of their academic journey. The platform connects students with a certified educator who can answer questions and provide contextualized feedback on exactly where the student went wrong in the learning process.

about_short_description.short_description: Paper is an educational support system that provides personalized tutoring accessible to every student.

product.name: GROW High-Impact Tutoring
product.description: A classroom-aligned, live virtual tutoring program for targeted K–12 support, delivered in consistent small groups with the same tutor and tracked through ongoing assessments.

product.name: Paper 24/7 Academic Support
product.description: An on-demand, multilingual tutoring service that connects K–12 students with live tutors for unlimited, one-to-one help across subjects through a secure online platform.

product.name: Paper Review Center
product.description: An asynchronous writing-feedback service that provides students with tutor annotations and guidance on written work, including content, grammar, and structure.

product.name: Paper Teacher Solutions
product.description: A set of educator tools that helps teachers assign Paper support, generate standards-aligned learning checks, review student activity, and identify learning gaps.

product.name: District Implementation and Program Services
product.description: District-level design, launch, staffing, monitoring, and reporting services that support the deployment of Paper tutoring programs in schools.
